'''Lufa Danak''' was a [[Neimoidian]] who served the [[Trade Federation]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic]]. In [[32 BBY]], Danak attended a meeting of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] where [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] asked for aid in stopping an [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of her [[homeworld]] [[Naboo]] by the Trade Federation. The Trade Federation [[senator]] [[Lott Dod]], with whom Danak shared a [[repulsorpod]], then objected to these claims.

==Biography==
Lufa Danak was a [[Neimoidian]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> who served the [[Trade Federation]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic]]. After the Federation [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY]]<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Danak attended a session of the Republic's [[Galactic Senate]] in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. The Neimoidian sat in a [[repulsorpod]] with the Federation's representative, [[Senator]] [[Lott Dod]], and another Neimoidian. During the session, [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] took to the floor to ask the senate for aid in stopping the invasion of her [[homeworld]] Naboo, but before she could even finish her plea, Dod moved the Federation's repulsorpod forward and objected, claiming that there was no proof an invasion was taking place.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:TF_Senate.png|thumb|left|250px|Danak accompanied Lott Dod in the Senate.]]
[[Senator]] [[Aks Moe]] of [[Malastare]] agreed with Dod, causing [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] to declare the point conceded and ask if Amidala would defer her motion to be investigated by a committee. Amidala refused to defer and called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum. This led to Valorum ultimately being replaced by Naboo's [[senator]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], while Amidala returned to Naboo and managed to [[Battle of Naboo|defeat]] the Federation forces there.<ref name="TPM" />

==Personality and traits==
Danak had [[Color|green]] skin and red [[eye]]s.<ref name="TPM" />

==Equipment==
Lufa Danak wore a black [[diplomat]]'s [[hat]] along with several layers of blue and purple [[Clothing|robes]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lufa Danak first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> For ''The Phantom Menace'' Lufa Danak's mask was sculpted by Gary Pollard.<ref name="100INTGP">{{YouTube|video=6fevC0IluiY|text=Gary Pollard - Creature Sculptor SW Ep 1 - FORCEMANIA (2023)|channel=Forcemania|name=Forcemania|date=2025-12-09}}</ref> In the current [[canon]], Danak was first identified in the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'', which was written by [[Adam Bray]], [[Tricia Barr]] and [[Cole Horton]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" article in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 147|147]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|147|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Devious Neimoidians Revealed}}</ref>
